independent_validation.method: worst seed per H1-H7 scenario; frozen proxy-v1 thresholds

limitations: This remains an internal proxy, not an official competition score.
Three seeds reduce but do not eliminate simulation generalization uncertainty.
The scenario definitions approximate the disclosed competition descriptions.
The policy, proxy formula and thresholds are frozen before these seeds are run.
scope: frozen Run06 policy; independent seeds; no training

h7_push_recovery_proxy.method: push at configured 4 s intervals; peak >=0.20 m/s; recovery <=0.15 m/s for 0.5 s

limitations: The exact official tracking-score transform is not disclosed; self_assessment is internal proxy v1.
Proxy-v1 thresholds were frozen after viewing partial H4/H6/H7 telemetry; those cases are calibration, not independent validation.
One checkpoint and one fixed seed do not establish generalization.
The H7 recovery calculation is an internal proxy, not an official score definition.
A completed run is evidence collection, not an automatic PASS decision.

self_assessment.method: internal proxy v1; survival * exp(-(tracking_RMSE/0.5)^2); worst case for paired directions
